card.title: The Warning Was Already Here
card.instruction: Choose one early detail as the warning sign, then let every later development reveal a larger version of the same disaster.

transfer.action: I'm watching the small crack beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: That little crack was the warning. {request}
transfer.response: Now the whole piano is leaning into it. The crack is taking more of the room. {counter}
transfer.challenge: The front row's tilting. I'm clearing the hall.
transfer.closing: It's reached the audience. I'll clear the balcony before that little crack takes the whole concert downstairs.

originalTransfer.action: I put the earliest warning sketch beside {prop}.
originalTransfer.opening: We called that crack decoration at the beginning. {request}
originalTransfer.challenge: We need to fix today's damage.
originalTransfer.closing: Start where yesterday tried to make itself noticed quietly.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: I said that tiny crack in the stage was a warning.

card.title: The Warning Was Already Here
card.instruction: Choose one early detail as the warning sign, then let every later development reveal a larger version of the same disaster.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: The first wedding invitation came back misspelled. That was the warning.

originalDialogue.speaker: B
originalDialogue.text: Now the cake names the wrong couple.

originalDialogue.speaker: B
originalDialogue.text: The venue has two weddings booked.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: There it is. The typo has acquired a building.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They misspelled our wedding invitation. That was the warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake names another couple. Help me scrape it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same mistake, larger icing budget. Pass me a knife.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They booked that couple into our reception room too. We've both paid; I'm offering half.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The typo's taking half our wedding. Before you offer them my chair, check which name's on it.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
